saved_media_surface_label: Example Watch Later, playlist, and offline-library posture for official voter-information media routes
delivery_role_note: The service reviews platform-managed saved-media surfaces so Watch Later items, saved playlists, offline downloads, and auto-filled download libraries remain subordinate to the current recording and the named help lane rather than quietly becoming a shadow private shelf of still-current official answers.

reviewed_saved_media_contexts.context_note: Reviewed whether the official recording can be saved for later inside the platform and whether reopening from that saved state preserves recovery to the current written help lane.
Reviewed whether the official recording can sit beside older, unrelated, or mixed-scope videos inside playlists or other saved-media shelves.
Reviewed whether the recording can be reopened offline inside the platform app and how the route signals that offline operability is not the same thing as currentness.
Reviewed whether recommended or auto-filled downloads can place other videos beside the official recording and make the saved library feel like one coherent official set.

saved_media_provenance_note: The service distinguishes viewer-managed saves, office-authored playlists, and platform-shaped auto-filled download shelves.
offline_freshness_boundary_note: A video that still opens from Watch Later, a playlist, or an offline library is treated as a saved-media convenience surface rather than proof that the recording remains current.
playlist_and_library_adjacency_note: Mixed playlists and saved-media libraries are reviewed for scope drift so one official recording does not cause neighboring videos to inherit the same authority.
auto_filled_downloads_note: If the platform can add recommended videos to offline downloads or similar saved-media shelves, the route treats those additions as adjacent media rather than as office-reviewed continuity.
current_help_recovery_note: When saved-media surfaces could mislead, the route points back to the current official page, reviewed FAQ/help entry, or named office contact instead of pretending the saved or offline media item is automatically controlling.
